Figure 1 presents two distinct line graphs, labeled A and B, both plotting data against the same horizontal axis representing years. The graphs illustrate trends in two different variables over time from 2008 to 2021.

Graph A plots “Средни легодни (дни)” (Average leg days) on its vertical axis. The scale is linear, ranging from 200 to 280, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 20 (200, 220, 240, 260, 280). The horizontal axis, labeled “Години” (Years), spans from 2008 to 2021, with labeled tick marks at 2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021. A single red line connects data points, marked with solid red circles. The line begins at approximately 280 in 2008, dips to approximately 260 in 2012/2013, rises to approximately 270 in 2017, and then falls to approximately 200 in 2021.

Graph B plots “Структурен ефект върху тях (%),” (Structural effect on them (%)) on its vertical axis. The scale is linear, ranging from 0.0 to 2.0, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.5 (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0). The horizontal axis, also labeled “Години” (Years), spans from 2008 to 2021, with labeled tick marks at 2008, 2012/2013, 2017, and 2021. A single red line connects data points, marked with solid red circles. The line begins at approximately 1.5 in 2008, falls to approximately 0.5 in 2012/2013, rises to approximately 1.5 in 2017, and then increases sharply to approximately 2.0 in 2021.
